info.title: QoS_DSCP_Map_Entry
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [QoS_DSCP_Map_Entry](#/QoS_DSCP_Map_Entry)
Contains references to each entry in the global DSCP map used by port trust mode DSCP. (see [QoS_DSCP_Map_Entry](#/QoS_DSCP_Map_Entry))

active_color.description: The color currently implemented in hardware.

active_local_priority.description: The local-priority currently implemented in hardware.

active_priority_code_point.description: The 802.1Q priority currently being assigned to packets with this codepoint.

code_point.description:
Reference Resource: [QoS_DSCP_Map_Entry](#/QoS_DSCP_Map_Entry)
The identifier for an entry in the DSCP map that represents the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value for this entry.

color.description: It may be used later in the pipeline in packet-drop decision points. The default is 'green'.

description.description: Used for customer documentation. When empty, the default_description key value from the hw_defaults column will be used.

default_code_point.description: The identifier for an entry in the DSCP map that represents the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value for this entry.

default_description.description: Contains the description of the given Traffic  Type (e.g. AF23).

default_local_priority.description: When missing, the default local_priority is obtained from the [hw_defaults](QoS_DSCP_Map_Entry.hw_defaults) of the [QoS_COS_Map_Entry](QoS_COS_Map_Entry) row indexed by the top 3-bits of this row's code_point (i.e. class selector bits cs0 through cs7).

default_priority_code_point.description: When missing, the default is not to remark packet 802.1Q priorities.

local_priority.description: This is a switch internal meta-data value that will be associated with the packet. This value will be used later to select the egress queue for the packet. When empty, the default_local_priority key value from the hw_defaults column will be used.

priority_code_point.description: The 802.1Q Priority Code Point (PCP) that will be assigned to any IP packet with the specified DSCP codepoint, if that packet's ingress port has an effective trust mode of `trust dscp`.  The new PCP is used when the packet is transmitted out a port or trunk with a VLAN tag.  If the key is not specified, then no remark will occur.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
